input.title: Men's Lacrosse – Played Lacrosse. Will Bring It Up. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

PLAYED LACROSSE. WILL BRING IT UP. is the lacrosse hoodie for the former player who turns every conversation back to the old days, worn at games, at alumni weekends and as a gift from a team that has heard every story twice.

PLAYED LACROSSE. runs across the top in collegiate slab capitals and WILL BRING IT UP. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a smug 1970s player with a red headband and long feathered hair leans back on a wooden bench in a green striped sweater, a lacrosse stick across his lap, his red helmet next to him and one hand raised mid-story, with grass tufts under the bench.

Navy carries cream and kelly green lettering with a cream edge around the player; Sand gets navy and deep red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this lacrosse hoodie warm enough for sideline games and cool evenings?
Yes. The Played Lacrosse. Will Bring It Up. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for sideline games, alumni weekends and cool evenings.

How does the Played Lacrosse. Will Bring It Up. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a lacrosse player?
It is a natural one. Every former player has a story that starts with his lacrosse days, so it lands with teammates, coaches, alumni and the family that has heard it twice. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the bench scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Played Lacrosse. Will Bring It Up. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
